description: Multimodal AI course aim on building AI systems that operate across modalities - vision, language, audio, video, 3D, and embodiment. The course frames multimodality through four core problems (representation, alignment, fusion, translation) and proceeds through cross-modal representations (CLIP, SigLIP, ImageBind), fusion architectures (cross-attention, Perceiver, Q-Former, gated cross-attention), vision-language and unified models (LLaVA, BLIP-2, Flamingo, Chameleon/Janus families), speech and audio, video and world models, 3D and embodied agents, multimodal reasoning / agents / RAG, evaluation (benchmark saturation, hallucination), efficiency and deployment, and safety/provenance/frontiers. Mathematical depth is assumed from the prerequisites (Deep Learning, Advanced Generative AI); this course focuses on architectures, training recipes, evaluation, and hands-on multimodal systems.
tools:
`- Python 3.10+ with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers
- Google Colab or Jupyter Notebook (GPU access for labs)
- A code/text editor (e.g., VS Code) - Open-weight VLMs (LLaVA/SigLIP/Whisper families)
- Datasets via Hugging Face Datasets (COCO, VQA, AudioSet, video benchmarks)
